name: blunt
_comment: Day one, after the first agent-driven scalping wave: 'no bots' in the terms and a
hard block on every signal an agent emits. It stops the farm. Run it and read who
else it stops: every shopper who let an agentic browser do the browsing, every
screen-reader user whose assistive agent drives the page, and every signed cloud
agent, which is the only kind you could ever identify.
